outletTypes.outlet: Standard WaffleUp outlet. Quick-dispatch window / drive-in model, typically 180-250 sq ft. Walk-in, takeaway, sit-in-car. Also sells through delivery platforms.
outletTypes.chefs_table: Chef's Table co-branded location. Separate menu artwork, higher price book, runs on Chef's Table's own ZAB POS. NO Foodpanda storefront — delivery is not available at CT.
outletTypes.cloud_kitchen: Delivery-only. No walk-in, no dine-in flows. Foodpanda commission runs materially higher here (~31.6% vs ~27.6%).
outletTypes.event_cart: Temporary setup for corporate events, concerts, schools, universities, weddings.

posSystems.giantsoft: Giant POS. Original system, current system for all standard outlets. Report exports are filename-stamped with a .NET tick (e.g. 639220220886550000.csv), NOT with the outlet or the date — you must record both by hand on export.
posSystems.otomatic: Historic. Used for a period between the two GiantSoft eras. No longer in use. Any pre-switch trend line is broken across this boundary.
posSystems.zab: ZAB Framework by Orange Solutions Ltd. Chef's Table's own POS, used at all 4 CT outlets. One export covers all shops. Identify the shop by the INVOICE prefix (DO01 / DO04 / DO05 / DO13), not the item code — the item-code format changed on 16 Jul 2026 from 8-digit shop-prefixed to IC--NNNNNN and no longer carries the shop. The detail export also duplicates item-line pages; aggregate by invoice sub-total or you will overstate CT by ~29%.
posSystems.foodpanda: Foodpanda merchant portal. Order-level export, one row per order, all storefronts in one file. This is a channel report, not a POS — a Foodpanda order at Dhanmondi also exists in GiantSoft.

CLOUD.note: Banani only — trades under a separate BIN. Any consolidated VAT or revenue view must handle this split.
